answer: Like a mirror that only reflects what stands before it, a staking bond forces each agent to lock collateral before it can transact; a raven-like peer-attestation graph then cross-checks behavior, so a fake identity that never earns endorsements stays isolated. Newcomers start with opal-grade, low-trust limits that rise only through verified useful work, making a thousand fake accounts cost a thousand bonds and a thousand reputations to build, far more than any single payout is worth.
